facts.label: Preço e instruções
facts.sub: Use how much para perguntar preços e o verbo base para instruções: How much is one wash? Put your clothes here. Close the door, please.

facts.label: Preços
facts.sub: Para perguntar o preço, use How much is…? How much is one wash? How much is the dryer? Para uma coisa que não se conta, como sabão, use How much soap do I need?

facts.label: Imperativo
facts.sub: Para dar instruções, use o verbo base, sem sujeito: Put your clothes here. Pour the soap. Close the door. Wait here. Acrescente please para ficar gentil.

pages.title: A bright laundromat · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Sunday evening in a bright laundromat in Austin. Machines hum in a long row. The air smells like soap. Boris counts quarters at the desk. Leo comes in with a big basket. He does not know the machines.
“Hi! First time here? Put your clothes in this washer.” says Boris. “Yes. How much is one wash?” says Leo. “It’s four dollars. Use quarters, please.” says Boris.
